content.title: IO-Link System Overview
content.content: IO-Link: point-to-point communication (IEC 61131-9). Master connects to PLC via fieldbus (PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT). Up to 8 ports per master. Sensors/actuators with IO-Link interface. Parameter server for automatic backup/restore. LR DEVICE for device description (IODD). LR AGENT for master configuration.

content.title: Master Types
content.content: Compact: AL1100 (4-port, IP67), AL1120 (8-port, IP67). Cabinet: AL1140 (8-port, IP20), AL1300 (16-port, IP20). Fieldbus: PROFINET (IRT/RT), EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CC-Link IE Field. Power: Class A (24V), Class B (24V + actuator supply). Diagnostics: per-port LED, web server, JSON REST API.

content.title: Smart Sensor Portfolio
content.content: Position: inductive, capacitive, magnetic, photoelectric. Process: pressure, temperature, flow, level. Identification: RFID, 1D/2D code readers. Condition monitoring: vibration, oil quality. All with IO-Link: parameterization, diagnostics, process data, events. IODD files for integration.

content.title: Parameter Server & Data Storage
content.content: Automatic parameter backup when device connected. Restore on device replacement (plug & play). Data storage index (0-3) for multiple configurations. Vendor-specific vs standard parameters. Block parameterization for commissioning. LR AGENT for bulk configuration.

content.title: moneo Software Suite
content.content: moneo|configure: parameter management, IODD library. moneo|monitor: real-time visualization, dashboards. moneo|analyze: historical analysis, reports. moneo|remote: secure remote access. Cloud or on-premise. Integration with IT systems via REST API, OPC UA, MQTT.

content.title: SICK Sensor Portfolio
content.content: Comprehensive industrial sensors: photoelectric, proximity, registration, distance, vision, LiDAR, RFID, safety. Communication: IO-Link, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, PROFIsafe, CIP Safety. Software: SOPAS ET (Engineering Tool), SICK AppSpace, SICK AppPool. Cloud: SICK Cloud Services.

content.title: Vision Sensors & Cameras
content.content: Inspector series: 2D vision (Inspector P, I, 83x). Lector series: code reading (1D/2D/DPM). Ranger: 3D vision. InspectorP: deep learning. Configuration: SOPAS ET, web server. Interface: EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, TCP/IP. Trigger: hardware, software, free-run. Output: results, images, statistics.

content.title: LiDAR Sensors
content.content: TiM series: 2D LiDAR (indoor/outdoor). LMS: industrial 2D. MRS: multi-layer 3D. OutdoorScan: long-range. Navigation, collision avoidance, area monitoring. Interface: Ethernet, CAN, USB. ROS driver. Safe variants (SIL 2/PL d). Configuration: SOPAS ET.

content.title: Safe Sensors & Systems
content.content: Safety light curtains (deTec, C4000). Safety laser scanners (S3000, microScan3). Safety switches (i100, i110). Safety controllers (Flexi Soft, FX3-CPU). PROFIsafe, CIP Safety, FSoE. Safety Designer for configuration. Safe networking via safety PLC or safety gateway.

content.title: SICK AppSpace & AppPool
content.content: AppSpace: develop custom sensor apps (C++, Python). Run on sensor (edge computing). AppPool: marketplace for pre-built apps. Apps for: quality inspection, logistics, robotics, condition monitoring. Deployment via SOPAS ET or cloud. Licensing per sensor/app.

manuals.title: Banner Engineering Sensor Catalog & Integration Guide
manuals.model: Q4X, Q3X, Q2X, R-GAGE, QS18, QS30 Series

content.title: Sensor Portfolio
content.content: Photoelectric: opposed, retro-reflective, diffuse, background suppression. Measurement: laser distance (Q4X, R-GAGE), ultrasonic, radar. Vision: iVu, VE series. Wireless: SureCross (900 MHz, 2.4 GHz). Safety: light curtains, E-stops. IO-Link on most models. Banner CDS (Configuration & Diagnostic Software).

content.title: Q4X Laser Distance Sensor
content.content: Time-of-flight laser: 300mm-10m (class 1), 300mm-50m (class 2). mm resolution. IO-Link, 4-20mA, NPN/PNP. Background suppression. Multi-segment display. Teach-in via button or IO-Link. Applications: positioning, level, loop control, web break detection. Temperature compensation.

content.title: Radar Sensors (R-GAGE)
content.content: FMCW radar: 24 GHz (ISM band). Range: 0.3-40m. Penetrates: rain, fog, dust, plastic, glass. IO-Link, CAN, Modbus. Configurable field of view. Multi-target tracking. Applications: vehicle detection, level (solids/liquids), collision avoidance, bulk solids. No moving parts.

content.title: SureCross Wireless
content.content: Industrial wireless I/O. Gateway (DX80) + Nodes (inputs/outputs). 900 MHz (long range) or 2.4 GHz (global). FHSS (frequency hopping). Range: up to 3km (900 MHz), 1km (2.4 GHz). Self-healing mesh. Battery life: years. Security: AES-128. Modbus/TCP, EtherNet/IP gateway.
